elder.speaker: Elder
pages: Welcome, traveler. This is Town 1.
A monster has made its home in the dungeon to the north-east. The road to the next town runs right through it.
Buy what you need at the market stall, and visit the healer before you go.
Two great evils defeated! Word of you has spread to every town.
You defeated the Stone Warden! The road north to Town 2 is open. Safe travels!

healer.speaker: Healer
pages: Rest here and I'll restore your strength. I'll also record your journey.

kid.speaker: Kid
pages: Tip: press LB and RB to switch weapons and spells!
And if you hold A after swinging, you can do a spin attack!
Whoa, a bow! You can hit things from far away now.

villager1.speaker: Villager
pages: Press SELECT to look at your map.
In dungeons, finding the Dungeon Map shows every room!

innkeeper.speaker: Innkeeper
pages: Welcome to the inn, traveler. A warm bed and a save, free of charge.

traveler.speaker: Traveler
pages: I came from the crypt. The dark there is alive...
...and I dropped my wedding ring in the west room! Could you find it for me?
My ring! I'll never lose it again. Thank you!
If you're poisoned, drink an Antidote, or rest here at the inn.
That's it! My ring! Please, take this reward.
The west room of the crypt... the one with the heavy block.

town2_guard.speaker: Guard
pages: You beat the Warden? Then maybe you can handle the Shadow Crypt.
Light the torches with fire magic. That's all I know.
The Sorcerer is gone! I can finally sleep at night.

scholar.speaker: Scholar
pages: Shield Knights block attacks from the front. Hit them from the side or behind!
Magic that explodes around you, like Frost Ring or Thunder, gets past shields too.

town2_villager.speaker: Villager
pages: The blacksmith can upgrade your weapons.
A Sword +3 is a fine thing indeed.
You look strong! Level 8 at least.

town2_kid.speaker: Kid
pages: Some doors in the crypt are locked.
Keys open locked doors. The BIG key opens the boss door!
I heard you can push blocks, too.

farmer.speaker: Farmer
pages: Slimes! Slimes everywhere! They're eating my turnips.
Could you defeat 6 of them in the dungeon? I'll pay you!
My turnips are safe. Thank you, hero!
You did it! Here, take this.
Still slimes out there... 6 is what I need.

town3_guard.speaker: Guard
pages: The Frost Cavern is north. Bombs, friend. Bring bombs.
The Wyrm is gone and the snow is melting! You're a hero!

explorer.speaker: Explorer
pages: I'm studying the Frost Herbs that grow in the cavern.
Could you bring me 3 of them? I'll pay well.
My research is going wonderfully, thanks to you!
Three perfect Frost Herbs! Here's your reward.
Frost Herbs grow in hidden corners of the cavern. Some are across the water...

hunter.speaker: Hunter
pages: Yetis keep raiding our storehouse. Defeat 4 of them and I'll give you some of my bombs.
Not a yeti in sight. Good work!
Four yetis! Here, you earned these.
Yetis lurk in the Frost Cavern. Watch out for their snowballs.

town3_kid.speaker: Kid
pages: Did you know you can blow up cracked walls with bombs?
There's a cracked wall somewhere in town, too! Hee hee.

town4_greeter.speaker: Guard
pages: Welcome to Town 4!
...We're still building it. Come back in the next milestone.
